youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的辦電話套餐情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從走進商場手機店說要一張新卡、比較三個方案的流量與熱點、問每月多少錢與一次性開通費、算流量能撐多久、搞清楚合約要簽幾年與違約金、帶護照填表登記、當場換卡打通第一通電話，到第一次帳單看不懂、逐行核對金額後安心繳費，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Choosing a Phone Plan phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue) — a new customer walks into a mall phone store asking for a new SIM card, compares three plans and their data and hotspot, works out the monthly price with taxes and a one-time activation fee, estimates how long the data will last, decides how many years to sign for, registers with a passport, swaps the card and makes the very first call, then decodes a confusing first bill line by line. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, sorry to bother you.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，打擾一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No trouble at all, how can I help?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈtrʌbəl æt ɔl haʊ kæn aɪ hɛlp?/
dialogue.zh: 一點也不麻煩，需要什麼幫忙？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I just moved to this city.
dialogue.zh: 我剛搬到這座城市。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome! A new phone plan, maybe?
dialogue.zh: 歡迎！是想辦新的手機方案吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I need a new phone card.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ nid ə nu foʊn kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 對，我要一張新的電話卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A new SIM? That's easy to do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə nu sɪm? ðæts ˈizi tə du./
dialogue.zh: 新的電話卡嗎？那很容易辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to wait my turn?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə weɪt maɪ tərn?/
dialogue.zh: 是不是要先排隊等叫號？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you can just walk in.
dialogue.zh: 不用，直接來就能辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, the line outside was so long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ðə laɪn ˌaʊtˈsaɪd wʌz soʊ lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，外面排隊排好長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturdays are busy at this mall.
dialogue.zh: 這間商場週六一向很忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will all this take?
dialogue.zh: 全部辦完要多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About fifteen minutes, if you're ready.
dialogue.zh: 大約十五分鐘，如果你準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm ready, I have some time today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈrɛdi aɪ hæv səm taɪm təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我準備好了，今天有時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, let's start at this counter.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們就在這個櫃檯開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the right counter for new cards?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ðə raɪt ˈkaʊntər fɔr nu kɑrdz?/
dialogue.zh: 這個櫃檯是辦新卡的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you found the right place.
dialogue.zh: 對，你找對地方了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My old prepaid number stopped working.
dialogue.zh: 我舊的預付門號停用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did your balance run out?
dialogue.zh: 是餘額用完了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No signal since Sunday night.
dialogue.zh: 從週日晚上起就沒訊號了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That happens when credit runs low.
dialogue.zh: 餘額不夠時常常會這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I keep that old number?
dialogue.zh: 我可以保留舊號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but the switch takes a few days.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt ðə swɪtʃ teɪks ə fju deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過轉過去要幾天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, I think I want a fresh number.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm aɪ θɪŋk aɪ wɑnt ə frɛʃ ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我想乾脆要個新號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A fresh start, that's very common.
dialogue.zh: 重新開始嘛，很常見的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I don't know anyone here yet.
dialogue.zh: 我在這兒還不認識任何人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So a local number will help you.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ə ˈloʊkəl ˈnʌmbər wɪl hɛlp ju./
dialogue.zh: 那當地的門號會幫到你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friends back home say the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ frɛndz bæk hoʊm seɪ ðə seɪm./
dialogue.zh: 家鄉的朋友也這樣說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're right, it feels more real.
dialogue.zh: 他們說得對，感覺更實在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you speak a little slowly, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju spik ə ˈlɪtəl ˈsloʊli pliːz?/
dialogue.zh: 請你講慢一點好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, I'll take it slow.
dialogue.zh: 當然，我會慢慢說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, my English is still growing.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju maɪ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪz stɪl ˈɡroʊɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我的英文還在進步。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're doing fine, keep going.
dialogue.zh: 你講得很好，繼續加油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell the cards here too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju sɛl ðə kɑrdz hɪr tu?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡也賣電話卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we keep them right behind me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi kip ðɛm raɪt bɪˈhaɪnd mi./
dialogue.zh: 有的，卡就在我身後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a new phone part of this?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ə nu foʊn pɑrt əv ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 那我還得買一支新手機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, do you already have one?
dialogue.zh: 不用，你手上已經有手機了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I brought my own phone today.
dialogue.zh: 我今天帶了自己的手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even better, is it unlocked?
dialogue.zh: 那就更好了，是解鎖機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Unlocked? What does that mean?
dialogue.zh: 解鎖？那是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It means it works on any network.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt minz ɪt wɜrks ɑn ˈɛni ˈnɛtˌwɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 就是哪個網路都能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think so, I bought it last year.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk soʊ aɪ bɔt ɪt læst jɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我想是，去年買的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we can test it right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi kæn tɛst ɪt raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那我們現在就先測試一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, test it before we sign anything.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tɛst ɪt bɪˈfɔr wi saɪn ˈɛniθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 好，簽約前先測試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, I'll check the card size.
dialogue.zh: 應該的，我來確認卡的大小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What size does my phone need?
dialogue.zh: 我的手機要哪種尺寸？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most new phones take a nano card.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst nu foʊnz teɪk ə ˈnænoʊ kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 新手機大多要用奈米卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How will I know if it fits?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ wɪl aɪ noʊ ɪf ɪt fɪts?/
dialogue.zh: 我怎麼知道合不合？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The card breaks into three small sizes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑrd breɪks ˈɪntu θri smɔl ˈsaɪzɪz./
dialogue.zh: 一張卡可拆成三種尺寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, I was worried about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd aɪ wʌz ˈwɜrid əˈbaʊt ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我正擔心這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't worry, it always works out.
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，一定對得上的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And this old card, what now?
dialogue.zh: 那舊的那張卡，現在怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll show you how to swap it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil ʃoʊ ju haʊ tə swɑp ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們會教你換卡的步驟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I lost the little plastic frame.
dialogue.zh: 那個小塑膠框我弄丟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, here's a spare for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm hɪrz ə spɛr fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，這裡有一個備用的給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that the tool for the tray?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ðə tuːl fɔr ðə treɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 那個小工具是開卡槽用的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, it's called an ejector tool.
dialogue.zh: 對，它叫取卡針。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use a paperclip instead?
dialogue.zh: 我可以用迴紋針代替嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a small paperclip works too.
dialogue.zh: 可以，小迴紋針也行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I have one in my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ hæv wʌn ɪn maɪ bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 好，我包裡剛好有一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you're all set for later.
dialogue.zh: 那等一下換卡就方便了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Later? Don't I change it today?
dialogue.zh: 等一下？我今天不用換卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We activate first, then you swap.
dialogue.zh: 先開通，然後才換卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Activate? What does that word mean?
dialogue.zh: 開通？那個詞是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It means we turn your line on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt minz wi tɜrn jʊr laɪn ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 就是讓你的門號開始運作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, simple words, I like that.
dialogue.zh: 啊，用簡單的詞，我喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I use plain words, not fancy ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ juz pleɪn wɜrdz nɑt ˈfænsi wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 我只用淺白的詞，不用難的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what is the first step?
dialogue.zh: 那麼，第一步是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, tell me how you use your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst tɛl mi haʊ ju juz jʊr foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 先告訴我你怎麼用手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mostly for calls and short videos.
dialogue.zh: 主要是打電話和看短影片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, that helps me a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ðæt hɛlps mi ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 了解了，這對我有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I ride the train every day.
dialogue.zh: 我每天搭火車通勤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So you watch videos on the ride?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ju wɑtʃ ˈvɪdioʊz ɑn ðə raɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 所以你在車上看影片？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, mostly on the way home.
dialogue.zh: 對，主要在回家的路上看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good to know, video eats data fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ ˈvɪdioʊ its ˈdeɪtə fæst./
dialogue.zh: 幸好知道了，影片很耗流量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is data the same as internet?
dialogue.zh: 流量跟網際網路是一樣的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On a phone, yes, basically the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ə foʊn jɛs ˈbesɪkli ðə seɪm./
dialogue.zh: 在手機上差不多是同一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I still mix up those two words.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ stɪl mɪks ʌp ðoz tu wɜrdz./
dialogue.zh: 那兩個詞我常搞混。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Many people do, don't worry about it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛni ˈpipəl du doʊnt ˈwɜri əˈbaʊt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 很多人都這樣，不用在意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, what happens next then?
dialogue.zh: 好，那接下來呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next, I'll show you our three plans.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst aɪl ʃoʊ ju ˈaʊər θri plænz./
dialogue.zh: 接下來帶你看我們的三種方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three plans? Which one do people pick?
dialogue.phonetic: /θri plænz? wɪtʃ wʌn du ˈpipəl pɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 三種？大家都選哪一種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The middle one is popular with newcomers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɪdəl wʌn ɪz ˈpɑpjələr wɪð ˈnjuˌkʌmərz./
dialogue.zh: 中間那個最受新客人歡迎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, is that the student plan?
dialogue.zh: 等等，那個是學生方案嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, this one is open to everyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðɪs wʌn ɪz ˈoʊpən tu ˈɛvriˌwʌn./
dialogue.zh: 不，這個誰都能看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have them printed somewhere?
dialogue.zh: 有印出來的清單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, here's a card for you.
dialogue.zh: 當然，這張方案卡給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This page is smaller than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs peɪdʒ ɪz ˈsmɔlər ðæn aɪ θɔt./
dialogue.zh: 這一頁比我以為的小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All the important parts fit here.
dialogue.zh: 重點全都放在這張小卡上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take my time with this?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ teɪk maɪ taɪm wɪð ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以慢慢看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, there's no rush today.
dialogue.zh: 當然，今天不用趕時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll start at the top line.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪl stɑrt æt ðə tɑp laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 好，我從最上面那行看起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll point to the cheapest plan.
dialogue.zh: 我來指最便宜的那個方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The top row says the word Basic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɑp roʊ sɛz ðə wɜrd ˈbeɪsɪk./
dialogue.zh: 最上面那行寫著基礎方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Basic is the simple one.
dialogue.zh: 對，基礎方案是最單純的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Simple sounds good, start with that.
dialogue.zh: 單純的不錯，就先聽這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I'll read it row by row.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪl rid ɪt roʊ baɪ roʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那我一行一行唸給你聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please say every number out loud.
dialogue.zh: 每個數字都請唸出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will, ask me anything anytime.
dialogue.zh: 會的，隨時問我任何事都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing before we begin.
dialogue.zh: 開始前還有一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what's on your mind?
dialogue.zh: 好呀，你想問什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, tell me about the Basic plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ tɛl mi əˈbaʊt ðə ˈbeɪsɪk plæn./
dialogue.zh: 那麼，跟我說說基礎方案吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Basic costs eighteen dollars a month.
dialogue.zh: 基礎方案每個月十八元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eighteen, that number is easy.
dialogue.zh: 十八，這數字很好記。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It gives you eight gigabytes of data.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɡɪvz ju eɪt ˈɡɪɡəˌbaɪts əv ˈdeɪtə./
dialogue.zh: 每個月給你八GB的流量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is eight gigabytes a lot of data?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz eɪt ˈɡɪɡəˌbaɪts ə lɑt əv ˈdeɪtə?/
dialogue.zh: 八GB算多嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's our smallest package, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，這是我們最小的方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much video can that carry?
dialogue.zh: 那些流量夠看多少影片？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A few videos, then it runs dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fju ˈvɪdioʊz ðɛn ɪt rʌnz draɪ./
dialogue.zh: 看幾部影片，流量就見底了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the train, that goes fast.
dialogue.zh: 在火車上一下就見底。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, streaming burns data quickly.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，串流特別耗流量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, what else do I get?
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn, wʌt ɛls du aɪ ɡɛt?/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，還能得到別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Unlimited calls and unlimited texts.
dialogue.zh: 電話和簡訊都不限量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Unlimited means no counting at all?
dialogue.zh: 不限量就是完全不用計數？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, call as long as you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli kɔl æz lɔŋ æz ju laɪk./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，想講多久就講多久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those calls only inside the city?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðoz kɔlz ˈoʊnli ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈsɪti?/
dialogue.zh: 這些電話只能在市內打嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any call inside this country, no limit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni kɔl ɪnˈsaɪd ðɪs ˈkʌntri noʊ ˈlɪmɪt./
dialogue.zh: 只要在本國境內，通通不限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about calling my family abroad?
dialogue.zh: 那打給國外的家人呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not on this plan, you'd need an add-on.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ɑn ðɪs plæn jʊd nid ən ˈæd ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 這方案不行，得加購服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An add-on? Like an extra service?
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˈæd ɑn? laɪk ən ˈɛkstrə ˈsɜrvɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 加購？像是額外付費的那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you pay more to call overseas.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ju peɪ mɔr tə kɔl ˌoʊvərˈsiz./
dialogue.zh: 對，多付錢才能打國際電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, what's the next plan then?
dialogue.zh: 好，那下一個方案呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The middle one is called Plus.
dialogue.zh: 中間那個叫Plus方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plus sounds like a friendly name.
dialogue.zh: Plus聽起來挺親切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's our most popular plan, actually.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，它是我們最受歡迎的方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much data does Plus include?
dialogue.zh: Plus包含多少流量？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-five gigabytes every single month.
dialogue.zh: 每個月二十五GB。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty-five! That's a big jump up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti faɪv! ðæts ə bɪɡ dʒʌmp ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 二十五！跳好多啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And it still has unlimited calls and texts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪt stɪl hæz ʌnˈlɪmɪtəd kɔlz ænd tɛksts./
dialogue.zh: 通話和簡訊照樣不限量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The same unlimited calls as Basic?
dialogue.zh: 通話跟基礎方案一樣不限？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The same, word for word.
dialogue.zh: 一模一樣，一字不差。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there anything else inside Plus?
dialogue.zh: Plus裡面還有別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It adds five gigabytes of hotspot.
dialogue.zh: 它多了五GB的熱點流量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hotspot? I've heard that word before.
dialogue.zh: 熱點？這詞我好像聽過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shares your phone's internet with your laptop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃɛrz jʊr foʊnz ˈɪntərˌnɛt wɪð jʊr ˈlæpˌtɑp./
dialogue.zh: 就是把手機的網分享給筆電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I use my laptop at coffee shops.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ juz maɪ ˈlæpˌtɑp æt ˈkɔfi ʃɑps./
dialogue.zh: 我常在咖啡店用筆電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the hotspot comes in handy.
dialogue.zh: 那熱點就派上用場了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Isn't coffee shop wifi free already?
dialogue.zh: 咖啡店的網不是免費的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Often yes, but it isn't always safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔfən jɛs bʌt ɪt ˈɪzənt ˈɔlweɪz seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 常常是，可不一定安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That scares me a little, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我有點害怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's when your own hotspot helps.
dialogue.zh: 這時自己的熱點就幫得上忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the last plan, the Max one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə læst plæn ðə mæks wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 最後那個，Max方案呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Max is forty-five dollars a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæks ɪz ˈfɔrti faɪv ˈdɑlərz ə mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: Max每個月四十五元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For forty-five, what do I get?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈfɔrti faɪv wʌt du aɪ ɡɛt?/
dialogue.zh: 花四十五能買到什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Unlimited data, it never runs out.
dialogue.zh: 流量無限，永遠用不完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never, even with heavy video use?
dialogue.zh: 就算大量看影片也不會有事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, you could stream all day.
dialogue.zh: 真的，整天串流都沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does Max include the hotspot as well?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz mæks ɪnˈklud ðə ˈhɑtˌspɑt æz wɛl?/
dialogue.zh: Max也有熱點功能嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, thirty gigabytes of hotspot data.
dialogue.zh: 有，三十GB的熱點流量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And overseas calls, are they free there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˌoʊvərˈsiz kɔlz ɑr ðeɪ fri ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 那國際電話在裡面免費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On Max, they're included, no add-on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn mæks ðɛr ɪnˈkludɪd noʊ ˈæd ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 在Max裡都包含了，不用加購。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, but that's more than I need.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs bʌt ðæts mɔr ðæn aɪ nid./
dialogue.zh: 很好，但那超出我的需要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's also our most expensive plan.
dialogue.zh: 它也是我們最貴的方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I see the three side by side?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ si ði θri saɪd baɪ saɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 能讓我並排看看三個方案嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look: data grows as the price grows.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk: ˈdeɪtə ɡroʊz æz ðə praɪs ɡroʊz./
dialogue.zh: 你看：流量跟著價格一起長大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight gigabytes, or twenty-five, or more.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈɡɪɡəˌbaɪts ɔr ˈtwɛnti faɪv ɔr mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 八GB、二十五GB，還是更多？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Max has no data cap at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæks hæz noʊ ˈdeɪtə kæp æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: Max的流量完全沒有上限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No limit, or just a huge number?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈlɪmɪt ɔr dʒʌst ə hjuːdʒ ˈnʌmbər?/
dialogue.zh: 是真沒上限，還是數字很大？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Truly unlimited, it never slows down.
dialogue.zh: 真的不限量，永遠不會變慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the prices, in that same order?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈpraɪsɪz ɪn ðæt seɪm ˈɔrdər?/
dialogue.zh: 那價格呢，也是這個順序嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighteen, twenty-eight, and forty-five.
dialogue.zh: 十八、二十八，還有四十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So who usually picks the Max plan?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ hu ˈjuʒuəli pɪks ðə mæks plæn?/
dialogue.zh: 那通常是誰會選Max？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: People on video calls all day long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpipəl ɑn ˈvɪdioʊ kɔlz ɔl deɪ lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 是整天都在視訊會議的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do that sometimes, but not enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du ðæt ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz bʌt nɑt ɪˈnʌf./
dialogue.zh: 我有時這樣，但沒那麼多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then Max is more phone than you need.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn mæks ɪz mɔr foʊn ðæn ju nid./
dialogue.zh: 那Max對你來說就買多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we put the Max aside for now?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi pʊt ðə mæks əˈsaɪd fɔr naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 先不把Max考慮進去好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, it stays on the menu.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm ɪt steɪz ɑn ðə ˈmɛnju./
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，它仍在選項裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, about the Basic and the Plus.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ əˈbaʊt ði ˈbeɪsɪk ænd ðə plʌs./
dialogue.zh: 現在說說基礎和Plus這兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, they are both good.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊr taɪm ðeɪ ɑr boʊθ ɡʊd./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢想，兩個都不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Basic may be too small for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbeɪsɪk meɪ bi tu smɔl fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 基礎方案對我可能太小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You watch video on the train.
dialogue.zh: 你每天都在火車上看影片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My videos really eat data fast.
dialogue.zh: 我的影片真的很吃流量。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight gigabytes would not last you.
dialogue.zh: 八GB撐不過一個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Run out around the second week, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌn aʊt əˈraʊnd ðə ˈsɛkənd wik, ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 會在第二週就用完？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Likely, if you keep streaming hard.
dialogue.zh: 若繼續猛看，幾乎一定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens the day it runs out?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈhæpənz ðə deɪ ɪt rʌnz aʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 用完那天會怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The internet becomes very, very slow.
dialogue.zh: 網速會變得非常慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay extra for slow data?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ peɪ ˈɛkstrə fɔr sloʊ ˈdeɪtə?/
dialogue.zh: 變慢的流量還要另外付錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but you may buy more data.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bʌt ju meɪ baɪ mɔr ˈdeɪtə./
dialogue.zh: 不用，但你可以加購流量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is one extra data pack?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz wʌn ˈɛkstrə ˈdeɪtə pæk?/
dialogue.zh: 加購包多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five dollars for five more gigabytes.
dialogue.zh: 五元加購五GB。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But paying that monthly would not be smart.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ˈpeɪɪŋ ðæt ˈmʌnθli wʊd nɑt bi smɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 但每個月都加購就不劃算了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you'd pay close to the Plus price.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn juːd peɪ kloʊs tə ðə plʌs praɪs./
dialogue.zh: 那樣花費就近似Plus的價位了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the cheap plan may not stay cheap.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə tʃip plæn meɪ nɑt steɪ tʃip./
dialogue.zh: 所以便宜的方案未必一直便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the trap many people fall into.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə træp ˈmɛni ˈpipəl fɔl ˈɪntu./
dialogue.zh: 這正是很多人踩過的坑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plus seems like the sensible middle.
dialogue.zh: Plus看來是合理的中間選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-eight a month, a fair price.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti eɪt ə mʌnθ, ə fɛr praɪs./
dialogue.zh: 每月二十八元，價格公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is Plus good for train videos though?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz plʌs ɡʊd fɔr treɪn ˈvɪdioʊz ðoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 那Plus夠我看車上影片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-five gigabytes should cover that easily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti faɪv ˈɡɪɡəˌbaɪts ʃʊd ˈkʌvər ðæt ˈizəli./
dialogue.zh: 二十五GB能輕鬆應付。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And five gigabytes for the laptop work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd faɪv ˈɡɪɡəˌbaɪts fɔr ðə ˈlæpˌtɑp wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 還有五GB給筆電用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough for a few short sessions.
dialogue.zh: 應付幾次短時段足夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So you'd suggest the Plus for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ juːd səɡˈdʒɛst ðə plʌs fɔr mi?/
dialogue.zh: 所以妳建議我選Plus？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fits what you told me today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt fɪts wʌt ju toʊld mi təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 它正合你今天說的需求。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like that you didn't push Max.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ðæt ju ˈdɪdənt pʊʃ mæks./
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡你們沒硬推Max。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The best plan is the one that fits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛst plæn ɪz ðə wʌn ðæt fɪts./
dialogue.zh: 最合適的才是最好的方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wallet thanks you for that, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈwɑlət θæŋks ju fɔr ðæt ˈtruli./
dialogue.zh: 我的錢包真心感謝妳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, that's a kind way to say it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ, ðæts ə kaɪnd weɪ tə seɪ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 哈，這說法真暖心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's go with the Plus plan, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ɡoʊ wɪð ðə plʌs plæn ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那就選Plus方案吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great choice, now let's talk money.
dialogue.zh: 選得好，接著來談錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, one more thing about the price.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wʌn mɔr θɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðə praɪs./
dialogue.zh: 對，價位還有一件事要問。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a discount you should hear first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ə ˈdɪsˌkaʊnt ju ʃʊd hɪr fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 有個折扣，你先聽聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A discount? Now I'm listening.
dialogue.zh: 打折？那我認真聽了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The listed price is twenty-eight a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɪstəd praɪs ɪz ˈtwɛnti eɪt ə mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 定價是每個月二十八元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You said twenty-eight already, right?
dialogue.zh: 你已經說過二十八了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but a longer term lowers it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt ə ˈlɔŋgər tɜrm ˈloʊərz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，綁久一點就能降價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much lower can it go?
dialogue.zh: 能降到多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-three dollars if you stay two years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti θri ˈdɑlərz ɪf ju steɪ tu jɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 願意簽兩年的話，每月二十三元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty-three! That saves five dollars.
dialogue.zh: 二十三！這樣省了五元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five dollars every month for two years.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈdɑlərz ˈɛvri mʌnθ fɔr tu jɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 兩年裡的每一個月都省五元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's one hundred twenty dollars saved.
dialogue.zh: 兩年就省下一百二十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your math checks out, you're quick.
dialogue.zh: 你算得正確，反應真快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For now, I like simple numbers.
dialogue.zh: 我現在喜歡簡單的數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, so here's the full picture.
dialogue.zh: 那我來把全貌說給你聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is twenty-three the final number?
dialogue.zh: 二十三元是最終價嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not quite, taxes come on top.
dialogue.zh: 還沒完，稅要再加在上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Taxes? How much do they add?
dialogue.zh: 稅？會加多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roughly four dollars every month.
dialogue.zh: 大約每個月四元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the real cost is about twenty-seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə riəl kɔst ɪz əˈbaʊt ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 所以實際上是每月二十七元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, that's the honest number.
dialogue.zh: 這才算是誠實的數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My old prepaid cost thirty-five.
dialogue.zh: 我舊的預付方案要三十五元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So this already saves you money.
dialogue.zh: 這樣已經在幫你省錢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, that fits inside my budget.
dialogue.zh: 好，這在我的預算之內。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's one small one-time fee.
dialogue.zh: 還有一筆小的一次性費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course there is, which one?
dialogue.zh: 當然有，是哪一筆？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A nine dollar activation fee, once.
dialogue.zh: 九元的開通費，只收一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine dollars just to turn it on?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈdɑlərz dʒʌst tə tɜrn ɪt ɑn?/
dialogue.zh: 光是開通就要九元？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It covers setting up your line.
dialogue.zh: 那是幫你建立門號的費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I can accept one fee.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，一次的費用我能接受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's only charged on your first bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈoʊnli tʃɑrdʒd ɑn jʊr fɜrst bɪl./
dialogue.zh: 它只會出現在第一張帳單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I see it printed there?
dialogue.zh: 帳單上會把它印出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every line item appears on bills.
dialogue.zh: 每一個項目都會列在帳單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there any other secret charges?
dialogue.zh: 還有別的隱藏費用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No roaming, no hidden service fees.
dialogue.zh: 沒有漫遊費，也沒有藏起來的服務費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hidden fees are my big nightmare.
dialogue.zh: 隱藏費用是我最怕的惡夢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll find none here, I promise.
dialogue.zh: 你在這兒碰不到的，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay for voicemail too?
dialogue.zh: 語音信箱也要錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Voicemail is free and included.
dialogue.zh: 語音信箱是免費送的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about operator help services?
dialogue.zh: 那查號台之類的服務呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You won't need that, just the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju woʊnt nid ðæt, dʒʌst ðə æp./
dialogue.zh: 你用不到，有app就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app costs nothing to use?
dialogue.zh: 那個app不用錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's free, and it tracks your data.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts fri, ænd ɪt træks jʊr ˈdeɪtə./
dialogue.zh: 免費，還能追蹤你的流量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I pay each month then?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ peɪ itʃ mʌnθ ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那每個月要怎麼付錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card in the app, or bank online.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrd ɪn ði æp, ɔr bæŋk ˌɑnˈlaɪn./
dialogue.zh: 用app刷卡，或是線上轉帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I still pay at your counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ stɪl peɪ æt jʊr ˈkaʊntər?/
dialogue.zh: 可以到你們櫃檯繳費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, cash is welcome here too.
dialogue.zh: 可以，這裡也收現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I might set up auto-pay later.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ maɪt sɛt ʌp ˈɔtoʊ peɪ ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 我之後可能設自動繳費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, it saves trips to this mall.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, ɪt seɪvz trɪps tə ðɪs mɔl./
dialogue.zh: 好呀，就省得跑來商場了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When will my first bill come?
dialogue.zh: 我第一張帳單什麼時候來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the first of next month, by email.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə fɜrst əv nɛkst mʌnθ, baɪ ˈiˌmeɪl./
dialogue.zh: 下個月一號，用電子郵件送你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I get a whole month first?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ ɡɛt ə hoʊl mʌnθ fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 所以我先用滿一個月？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roughly yes, then the bill arrives.
dialogue.zh: 差不多，然後帳單才來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And this month is not free?
dialogue.zh: 這個月不是免費的喔？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it rides on the first bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɪt raɪdz ɑn ðə fɜrst bɪl./
dialogue.zh: 不，它會算進第一張帳單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, so the first bill is bigger?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, soʊ ðə fɜrst bɪl ɪz ˈbɪɡər?/
dialogue.zh: 等等，所以第一張會比較大？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It should total around thirty-six dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʊd ˈtoʊtəl əˈraʊnd ˈθɜrdi sɪks ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 總額大約是三十六元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty-six now, and twenty-seven after?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrdi sɪks naʊ, ænd ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən ˈæftər?/
dialogue.zh: 現在三十六，之後二十七？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, the nine dollar fee appears once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli, ðə naɪn ˈdɑlər fi əˈpɪrz wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，那九元只出現一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fair, you told me early.
dialogue.zh: 很公道，你們說得早。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No surprises is our store rule.
dialogue.zh: 不讓人吃驚是我們店的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I change plans without a cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ tʃeɪndʒ plænz wɪˈðaʊt ə kɔst?/
dialogue.zh: 換方案要錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Switching costs nothing, any month.
dialogue.zh: 轉換不花錢，哪個月都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if one month I buy two packs?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf wʌn mʌnθ aɪ baɪ tu pæks?/
dialogue.zh: 那某一個月我買兩個加購包呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you pay ten for ten gigabytes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ju peɪ tɛn fɔr tɛn ˈɡɪɡəˌbaɪts./
dialogue.zh: 那就是十元買十GB。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten dollars, that's still cheap for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈdɑlərz, ðæts stɪl tʃip fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 十元，對我來說還算便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if it happens once in a while.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ɪt ˈhæpənz wʌns ɪn ə waɪl./
dialogue.zh: 不過偶爾為之才划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back to the add-on for overseas calls.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk tə ði ˈæd ɑn fɔr ˌoʊvərˈsiz kɔlz./
dialogue.zh: 回頭說國際電話的加購。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The overseas pack is fifteen a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˌoʊvərˈsiz pæk ɪz ˌfɪfˈtin ə mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 國際加購包每月十五元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifteen for how many minutes?
dialogue.zh: 十五元有幾分鐘？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hundred minutes to any country.
dialogue.zh: 一百分鐘，打哪個國家都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I call home twice a month, ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kɔl hoʊm twaɪs ə mʌnθ, tɛn ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 我每月打兩次回家，一共十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then skip the pack, pay by the minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn skɪp ðə pæk, peɪ baɪ ðə ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那就別加購，按分鐘付就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the minute is cheaper for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə ˈmɪnɪt ɪz ˈtʃipər fɔr mi?/
dialogue.zh: 按分鐘算對我比較便宜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, ten minutes is pocket change.
dialogue.zh: 那十分鐘只是零頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I'll leave the add-on off today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, aɪl liv ði ˈæd ɑn ɔf təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 好，今天先不加購。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can add it any month later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn æd ɪt ˈɛni mʌnθ ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 之後哪一個月想加都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So my honest monthly number is twenty-seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ ˈɑnɪst ˈmʌnθli ˈnʌmbər ɪz ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 所以我每個月實付二十七元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With taxes, yes, that's your number.
dialogue.zh: 含稅的話，對，就是你的數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does autopay change that number at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ˈɔtoʊˌpeɪ tʃeɪndʒ ðæt ˈnʌmbər ɔt ɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 自動繳費會讓數字變嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, same price, no extra discount.
dialogue.zh: 不會，價格一樣，沒有額外折扣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll pay it myself at first.
dialogue.zh: 我先自己手動繳費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That works, bills arrive by email.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，帳單會寄到信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask for paper bills too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æsk fɔr ˈpeɪpər bɪlz tu?/
dialogue.zh: 也可以要紙本帳單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just ask and we'll send them.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, dʒʌst æsk ænd wil sɛnd ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 可以，說一聲我們就寄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I am late with a payment?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ æm leɪt wɪð ə ˈpeɪmənt?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我晚繳了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A reminder first, then a five dollar fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə rɪˈmaɪndər fɜrst, ðɛn ə faɪv ˈdɑlər fi./
dialogue.zh: 會先提醒你，再來就是五元罰費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five dollars, not terrible.
dialogue.zh: 五元，還不算可怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still, set a phone reminder.
dialogue.zh: 不過還是設個手機提醒吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my service ever get paused?
dialogue.zh: 我的服務會被暫停嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only after thirty days unpaid.
dialogue.zh: 只有欠費超過三十天才會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair, I always pay early anyway.
dialogue.zh: 合理，反正我都會早點繳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the safest habit to keep.
dialogue.zh: 那是最保險的習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a deposit or anything?
dialogue.zh: 還有押金之類的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No deposit with a passport ID.
dialogue.zh: 有護照證件就不用押金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, deposits scare every newcomer.
dialogue.zh: 真好，押金會讓新人緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Newcomers get easy terms here.
dialogue.zh: 新客戶在我們這裡條件寬鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, the money part feels clear.
dialogue.zh: 好，錢的部分我弄清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, anything else about bills?
dialogue.zh: 關於帳單還有別的問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing right now, you covered it.
dialogue.zh: 目前沒事了，你都講到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's check how your data works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛts tʃɛk haʊ jʊr ˈdeɪtə wɜrks./
dialogue.zh: 那再來看看流量怎麼運作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, how long will my data last?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, haʊ lɔŋ wɪl maɪ ˈdeɪtə læst?/
dialogue.zh: 對，我的流量能撐多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the perfect next question.
dialogue.zh: 這個問題問得正好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, how many weeks does that last?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haʊ ˈmɛni wiːks dʌz ðæt læst?/
dialogue.zh: 那能撐幾週呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For you? About a full month.
dialogue.zh: 對你來說？大概整一個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A month, on my train habit?
dialogue.zh: 照我搭車的習慣，一個月？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If you watch half an hour a day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ju wɑʧ hæf ən ˈaʊər ə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 如果你每天看半小時的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much data does an hour take?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ˈdeɪtə dʌz ən ˈaʊər teɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 一小時會用掉多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roughly one gigabyte in normal quality.
dialogue.zh: 一般畫質大約一GB。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half a gigabyte, so fifteen a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ə ˈɡɪɡəˌbaɪt, soʊ ˌfɪfˈtin ə mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 半GB，一個月就是十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close, plus your other phone use.
dialogue.zh: 差不多，還要算別的用量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What else eats my data then?
dialogue.zh: 那還有什麼會吃流量？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maps, music, and app updates too.
dialogue.zh: 地圖、音樂，還有app更新。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: App updates? Those can be huge.
dialogue.zh: app更新？那些可以很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's why we keep some room left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts waɪ wi kip səm rum lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 所以要預留一些餘量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there room for music as well?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr rum fɔr ˈmjuzɪk æz wɛl?/
dialogue.zh: 音樂也還有空間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Music is small, you'll be fine.
dialogue.zh: 音樂很省，你沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I stream music at the gym too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ strim ˈmjuzɪk æt ðə dʒɪm tu./
dialogue.zh: 我在健身房也串流音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gym wifi can save that data.
dialogue.zh: 健身房的Wi-Fi能幫你省下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, I could use gym wifi then.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, aɪ kʊd juz dʒɪm ˈwaɪfi ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那我可以在健身房連網。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, any wifi you find saves data.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ˈɛni ˈwaɪfi ju faɪnd seɪvz ˈdeɪtə./
dialogue.zh: 對，連到Wi-Fi就省流量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So my home wifi saves the most.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ hoʊm ˈwaɪfi seɪvz ðə moʊst./
dialogue.zh: 所以家裡的Wi-Fi省最多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the biggest trick, use it daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈbɪɡɪst trɪk, juz ɪt ˈdeɪli./
dialogue.zh: 這就是最大的訣竅，天天用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens if I watch more?
dialogue.zh: 如果我看更多會怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'd reach maybe thirty gigabytes.
dialogue.zh: 那你可能用到三十GB。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And my plan only holds twenty-five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd maɪ plæn ˈoʊnli hoʊldz ˈtwɛnti faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 而我的方案只有二十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the last five come out slower.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ðə læst faɪv kʌm aʊt ˈsloʊər./
dialogue.zh: 對，最後那五GB會變慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slower means almost no internet?
dialogue.zh: 慢到幾乎沒有網？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Speed drops, but you're never cut off.
dialogue.phonetic: /spid drɑps, bʌt jʊr ˈnɛvər kʌt ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 速度會掉，但不會斷線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I still send photos then?
dialogue.zh: 那時候還能傳照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, photos just take longer.
dialogue.zh: 能，照片只是傳久一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And videos in that slow mode?
dialogue.zh: 那影片在慢速狀態呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They stop and start all the time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ stɑp ænd stɑrt ɔl ðə taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 它們會一直卡住又跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I remember that stop and start thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ rɪˈmɛmbər ðæt stɑp ænd stɑrt θɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我記得那種卡卡的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So watch your final week closely.
dialogue.zh: 所以最後一週要多留意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Week four is the danger zone?
dialogue.zh: 第四週是危險區？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually, if you stream hard daily.
dialogue.zh: 天天猛看的話，通常是的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does unused data go to next month?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ʌnˈjuzd ˈdeɪtə ɡoʊ tə nɛkst mʌnθ?/
dialogue.zh: 用剩的流量會留到下個月嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it resets on the first.
dialogue.zh: 不會，每個月的第一天歸零。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Resets? So what's left is gone?
dialogue.zh: 歸零？那剩的就沒了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that's normal on these plans.
dialogue.zh: 對，這些方案都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I see what I have left?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ si wʌt aɪ hæv lɛft?/
dialogue.zh: 我怎麼看還剩下多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the free app we mentioned.
dialogue.zh: 打開我說過的免費app。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app shows gigabytes I used?
dialogue.zh: app會顯示我用掉的GB？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It charts your use day by day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt tʃɑrts jʊr juz deɪ baɪ deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 它會一天一天畫給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can it warn me near the limit?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ɪt wɔrn mi nɪr ðə ˈlɪmɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 快到上限時它會警告嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, set an alert at twenty.
dialogue.zh: 會，設在二十GB就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty used, then the alert comes?
dialogue.zh: 用到二十，提醒就來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll get a small reminder text.
dialogue.zh: 你會收到一則小提醒簡訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, that keeps me in control.
dialogue.zh: 好，這樣我就掌控得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You stay the boss all month long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju steɪ ðə bɔs ɔl mʌnθ lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 整個月你都是自己的老闆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the five gigabyte hotspot?
dialogue.zh: 那五GB的熱點呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's separate, just for your laptop.
dialogue.zh: 那是獨立的，專給筆電用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does laptop video eat that fast?
dialogue.zh: 筆電影片很快吃掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very fast, the screen is bigger.
dialogue.zh: 很快，因為螢幕比較大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So hotspot is for short work only?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈhɑtˌspɑt ɪz fɔr ʃɔrt wɜrk ˈoʊnli?/
dialogue.zh: 所以熱點只能應付短工作？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, emails and light browsing.
dialogue.zh: 對，收信和輕鬆上網。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I buy extra hotspot data?
dialogue.zh: 熱點流量也能加購嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The boost pack works for it too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə buʊst pæk wɜrks fɔr ɪt tu./
dialogue.zh: 加購包對熱點也管用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five dollars, five more gigabytes.
dialogue.zh: 五元，再加五GB。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One tap in the app, done.
dialogue.zh: 在app上點一下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the boost reset each month?
dialogue.zh: 加購的會每月歸零嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stays until you use it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt steɪz ənˈtɪl ju juz ɪt ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 它會留到你用完為止。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, no waste in that part.
dialogue.zh: 好，這樣就不浪費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And it won't renew without you.
dialogue.zh: 沒有你點頭它也不會自己續。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No surprise repeats, perfect.
dialogue.zh: 不會偷偷重複買，太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We hear complaints about auto buys.
dialogue.zh: 常有人抱怨自動加購。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I lower my video quality?
dialogue.zh: 我可以調低畫質嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, most apps have a data saver.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, moʊst æps hæv ə ˈdeɪtə ˈseɪvər./
dialogue.zh: 可以，多數app有省流模式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A data saver, does it help much?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈdeɪtə ˈseɪvər, dʌz ɪt hɛlp mʌtʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 省流模式真的有用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It can cut usage almost in half.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kæn kʌt ˈjuzɪdʒ ˈɔlˌmoʊst ɪn hæf./
dialogue.zh: 用量幾乎能減一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half! That buys me extra days.
dialogue.zh: 一半！那能讓我多用幾天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, you'll gain a full week.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，你還能多撐一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So twenty-five could stretch further?
dialogue.zh: 所以二十五GB能拉更長？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easily, if you keep the saver on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizəli, ɪf ju kip ðə ˈseɪvər ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 只要開著省流模式，就撐得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if I go over anyway?
dialogue.zh: 如果我還是不小心超標呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow speed, no extra bill, remember.
dialogue.zh: 只有變慢，不會多扣錢，記得喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I remember, you said it twice.
dialogue.zh: 我記得，你說了兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because people fear surprise data bills.
dialogue.zh: 因為大家都怕流量爆帳單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With this, my mind is calm.
dialogue.zh: 這樣我就安心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, data is all settled now.
dialogue.zh: 流量的部分就這樣決定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there anything about night use?
dialogue.zh: 夜間使用有特別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some plans give free night data.
dialogue.zh: 有些方案夜間流量免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does Plus include that night bonus?
dialogue.zh: Plus有那個夜間好禮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the night bonus is on Max.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə naɪt ˈboʊnəs ɪz ɑn mæks./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，那個只在Max裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Max stays too much for me.
dialogue.zh: Max對我還是太多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, Plus already fits you.
dialogue.zh: 同意，Plus已經很合你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I switch plans later on?
dialogue.zh: 之後可以換方案嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any time, at the start of a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni taɪm, æt ðə stɑrt əv ə mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 隨時可以，月初換最順。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Up to Max, or down to Basic?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌp tə mæks, ɔr daʊn tə ˈbeɪsɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 升到Max，或降回基礎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Either way, the app handles it.
dialogue.zh: 哪個方向，app都能辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does switching break my number?
dialogue.zh: 換方案會弄丟我的號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, your number stays yours.
dialogue.zh: 永遠不會，號碼一直是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, that was my quiet worry.
dialogue.zh: 好，那是我暗暗擔心過的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Common worry, you're safe there.
dialogue.zh: 常有人擔心，但這點你放心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, data questions are finished.
dialogue.zh: 好，流量的問題問完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more topic waits: the contract.
dialogue.zh: 還有一個主題在等著：合約。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, the part people read last.
dialogue.zh: 啊，大家最後才看的那份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most sign it, then never look.
dialogue.zh: 多數人簽完就再也不看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before that, can I sit down?
dialogue.zh: 在那之前，我能坐一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, here's a chair for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs, hɪrz ə tʃɛr fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 當然，這把椅子給你坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, now let's talk contract.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，現在來談合約。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get comfortable, I'll bring the papers.
dialogue.zh: 坐舒服，我去拿文件過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, how many years can I sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst, haʊ ˈmɛni jɪrz kæn aɪ saɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 首先，最長可以簽幾年？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can stay month to month.
dialogue.zh: 你也可以一月一簽，不綁年限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Month to month, no contract at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌnθ tə mʌnθ, noʊ ˈkɑnˌtrækt æt ɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 一月一簽，完全不綁合約？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None at all, at twenty-eight dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn æt ɔl, æt ˈtwɛnti eɪt ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 完全不綁，只是要二十八元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That freedom costs five dollars more.
dialogue.zh: 那份自由要多花五元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Freedom has a price, yes.
dialogue.zh: 自由嘛，就是有價碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the two-year keeps twenty-three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə tu jɪr kipz ˈtwɛnti θri./
dialogue.zh: 兩年約就維持二十三元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, twenty-three every month for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ˈtwɛnti θri ˈɛvri mʌnθ fɔr ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 對，那兩年裡每月都是二十三。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if life changes in the middle?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf laɪf ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl?/
dialogue.zh: 如果中途生活變了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's what the early exit fee covers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts wʌt ði ˈɜrli ˈɛɡzɪt fi ˈkʌvərz./
dialogue.zh: 那就是提前解約金管的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The penalty, how bad can it be?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpɛnəlti, haʊ bæd kæn ɪt bi?/
dialogue.zh: 那個罰款，會有多重？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen dollars for each month left.
dialogue.zh: 剩下每個月罰十五元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifteen times the months I skip?
dialogue.zh: 剩幾個月就乘幾個十五？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, count the months you won't use.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli, kaʊnt ðə mʌnθs ju woʊnt juz./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，數數你沒用完的月份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say I leave after one full year.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ aɪ liv ˈæftər wʌn fʊl jɪr./
dialogue.zh: 假設我滿一年就退出。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then twelve months remain, times fifteen.
dialogue.zh: 那就剩十二個月，乘十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's one hundred eighty dollars.
dialogue.zh: 那就是一百八十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, that's what makes it risky.
dialogue.zh: 你看，這就是風險所在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do people really leave early?
dialogue.zh: 真的會有人提前走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A few, usually when moving away.
dialogue.zh: 少數，通常是搬去外地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I just move apartments?
dialogue.zh: 那只是換租屋處呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Apartments are fine, the line follows you.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈpɑrtmənts ɑr faɪn, ðə laɪn ˈfɑloʊz ju./
dialogue.zh: 搬家沒關係，門號跟著你走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if I fly home for a while?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf aɪ flai hoʊm fɔr ə waɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我飛回國住一陣子呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can pause service for two weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn pɔz ˈsɜrvɪs fɔr tu wikz./
dialogue.zh: 你可以暫停服務兩週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks a year, that's a gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wiks ə jɪr, ðæts ə ɡɪft./
dialogue.zh: 一年有兩週，那真划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, use them when you fly home.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, juz ðɛm wɛn ju flai hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 對，要回國時就用那兩週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the pause end my contract?
dialogue.zh: 暫停會讓合約結束嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it just extends the end date.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɪt dʒʌst ɪkˈstɛndz ði ɛnd deɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不會，只是往後延結束日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So two years of real service.
dialogue.zh: 所以是踏踏實實服務兩年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plus any pauses you truly need.
dialogue.zh: 再加上你真正需要的暫停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After two years, what happens?
dialogue.zh: 兩年之後會怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It becomes month to month at twenty-eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt bɪˈkʌmz mʌnθ tə mʌnθ æt ˈtwɛnti eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 就變回月租二十八，自由進出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The discount ends right there?
dialogue.zh: 折扣就在那裡結束？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, unless a new deal appears.
dialogue.zh: 對，除非又出現新優惠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you email me before that?
dialogue.zh: 那個時點前會發信通知我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We remind you a month ahead.
dialogue.zh: 我們會提前一個月提醒你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I hate quiet renewals.
dialogue.zh: 好，我討厭不知不覺的續約。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one can't trap you by surprise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn kænt træp ju baɪ sərˈpraɪz./
dialogue.zh: 這張合約不會偷偷困住你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me the paper contract now.
dialogue.zh: 現在把紙本合約給我看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, six short pages.
dialogue.zh: 在這兒，短短六頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six pages? I expected thick ones.
dialogue.zh: 六頁？我以為會很厚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small print still lives on each page.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl prɪnt stɪl lɪvz ɑn itʃ peɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 每頁難免還是有小字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I start reading?
dialogue.zh: 我該從哪裡讀起？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Page three holds the fee schedule.
dialogue.zh: 第三頁是費用一覽表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And my end date, where is that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd maɪ ɛnd deɪt, wɛr ɪz ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 那我的到期日在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bottom of page five, in bold letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑtəm əv peɪdʒ faɪv, ɪn boʊld ˈlɛtərz./
dialogue.zh: 第五頁最下面，用粗體寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bold letters, easy for me to catch.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊld ˈlɛtərz, ˈizi fɔr mi tə kæʧ./
dialogue.zh: 粗體字，那我就看得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It starts the day we activate.
dialogue.zh: 合約從開通那天起算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So twenty-four months from today?
dialogue.zh: 所以從今天起二十四個月？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the exact date gets printed.
dialogue.zh: 對，確切日期會印出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I sign today, or think first?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ saɪn təˈdeɪ, ɔr θɪŋk fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 我今天簽，還是先想一想？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it home if you want.
dialogue.zh: 想帶回去考慮也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, my mind is made up today.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, maɪ maɪnd ɪz meɪd ʌp təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 不用了，我心裡已經決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then tell me your choice clearly.
dialogue.zh: 那請明確告訴我你的選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The two-year at twenty-three dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tu jɪr æt ˈtwɛnti θri ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 兩年約，每個月二十三元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Solid, that's what I'd pick too.
dialogue.zh: 穩固的選擇，我也會這麼挑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the catch? There's always one.
dialogue.zh: 有什麼陷阱？一定有一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You promise two years, nothing else.
dialogue.zh: 你承諾兩年，別無其他條件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No phone loan hiding inside?
dialogue.zh: 裡面沒有藏手機貸款吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None, this covers service only.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，這份只管服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my phone is fully paid for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, maɪ foʊn ɪz ˈfʊli peɪd fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 好，我的手機早就付清了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then no device plan, nothing owed.
dialogue.zh: 那就沒有分期，也不欠錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes this whole thing lighter.
dialogue.zh: 這樣這份合約就輕鬆多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Light and fair, that's the point.
dialogue.zh: 又輕又公道，重點就在這。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you keep my signed copy?
dialogue.zh: 簽好的合約你們留一份嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You keep one, we scan one.
dialogue.zh: 你留正本，我們掃檔一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a PDF by email?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə ˌpiːdiˈɛf baɪ ˈiˌmeɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 能寄一份PDF給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, it arrives within a day.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm, ɪt əˈraɪvz wɪˈðɪn ə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，一天內就會送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I lose the paper copy?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ luz ðə ˈpeɪpər ˈkɑpi?/
dialogue.zh: 要是我把紙本弄丟了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Email us, we'll print it again.
dialogue.zh: 發信來，我們再補印一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a witness signature?
dialogue.zh: 需要見證人一起簽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just you and our store stamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, dʒʌst ju ænd ˈaʊər stɔr stæmp./
dialogue.zh: 不用，你簽名加我們蓋章。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your stamp? This feels official.
dialogue.zh: 蓋店章？感覺好正式。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost like a tiny ceremony.
dialogue.zh: 幾乎像一場小典禮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thing worries me, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，還有一事讓我擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it, we're nearly done here.
dialogue.zh: 說吧，我們快弄完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You said switching plans stays free?
dialogue.zh: 你說過換方案是免費的，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same rule, free inside the term.
dialogue.zh: 同一條規矩，合約中也自由換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful, that's generous of you.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，你們真大方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We want you to stay comfortable.
dialogue.zh: 我們要你簽得安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before I sign, one small check.
dialogue.zh: 簽名之前，我再確認一件小事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, what's the check?
dialogue.zh: 當然，你要確認什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The price holds for all twenty-four months?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə praɪs hoʊldz fɔr ɔl ˈtwɛnti fɔr mʌnθs?/
dialogue.zh: 這價格二十四個月都不變嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-three, fixed, taxes aside.
dialogue.zh: 二十三元鎖住，稅另外算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And taxes can wiggle a little?
dialogue.zh: 稅會稍微浮動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A dollar up or down, at most.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈdɑlər ʌp ɔr daʊn, æt moʊst./
dialogue.zh: 最多上下各一元左右。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that I can live with.
dialogue.zh: 好，這一點我承受得起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people never notice it.
dialogue.zh: 多數人根本不會注意到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where exactly do I sign?
dialogue.zh: 我確切要在哪裡簽名？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On page six, at the two X marks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn peɪdʒ sɪks, æt ðə tu ɛks mɑrks./
dialogue.zh: 第六頁，兩個畫叉的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Full name or short name?
dialogue.zh: 簽全名還是簡名？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full name, same as your passport.
dialogue.zh: 全名，跟護照上一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, the passport comes up again.
dialogue.zh: 啊，又提到護照了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It returns at registration, soon.
dialogue.zh: 等一下登記時它還會出場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One signature, then another.
dialogue.zh: 一個簽名，接著另一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pen is right here, take your time.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɛn ɪz raɪt hɪr, teɪk jʊr taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 筆就在這裡，慢慢寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the passport copy again, right?
dialogue.zh: 現在又要用到護照影本了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, registration copies it once.
dialogue.zh: 對，登記時會影印一份存著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, signed on both lines.
dialogue.zh: 好了，兩邊都簽好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, the passport and one more form.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ, ðə ˈpæspɔrt ænd wʌn mɔr fɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 接著是護照和最後一張表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, this is the form, right?
dialogue.zh: 所以，就是這張表對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, this one, just six blanks.
dialogue.zh: 對，這張，只有六個欄位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me find my glasses first.
dialogue.zh: 先讓我找出眼鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it slow, we have all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt sloʊ, wi hæv ɔl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，我們今天有的是時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, much better. First blank?
dialogue.zh: 啊，清楚多了。第一格？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full name, exactly like the passport.
dialogue.zh: 全名，照護照上一字不差。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. My writing is hard to read.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn. maɪ ˈraɪtɪŋ ɪz hɑrd tə rid./
dialogue.zh: 寫好了。我的字不太容易認。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll read it back to check.
dialogue.zh: 我會逐欄唸回來確認。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next is the home address line.
dialogue.zh: 下一格是住家地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Street first, then the number.
dialogue.zh: 先寫街道名，再寫號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I live on Maple Street, nine.
dialogue.zh: 我住楓街九號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, apartment number next.
dialogue.zh: 很好，接著寫房號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Apartment two oh four.
dialogue.zh: 兩零四室。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two oh four, got it exactly.
dialogue.zh: 兩零四，我記得分毫不差。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now a five digit code, right?
dialogue.zh: 再來是五碼郵遞區號吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Postal code, it's on your mail.
dialogue.zh: 郵遞區號，信封上就有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me check my bank letter.
dialogue.zh: 讓我翻一下銀行的信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No hurry, I'll wait right here.
dialogue.zh: 不急，我就在這裡等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, here are the digits.
dialogue.zh: 找到了，五個數字就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Copy them into that small box.
dialogue.zh: 把它們抄進那個小格子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Email for the bills comes next.
dialogue.zh: 接著是收帳單的信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it clearly, twice if unsure.
dialogue.zh: 寫清楚，不確定就寫兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One line, or letter by letter?
dialogue.zh: 寫一行，還是一個字母一個字母？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One line is fine, small letters.
dialogue.zh: 一行就好，用小寫字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last box: a backup phone number.
dialogue.zh: 最後一格：備用電話號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your roommate's number will work.
dialogue.zh: 你室友的號碼就很合適。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He'd hate being on my paperwork.
dialogue.zh: 他大概會嫌被寫上文件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's just in case we can't reach you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts dʒʌst ɪn keɪs wi kænt ritʃ ju./
dialogue.zh: 只是萬一找不到你時用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, the whole form is done.
dialogue.zh: 好，整張表都寫完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me read every field aloud.
dialogue.zh: 讓我逐欄唸給你聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do, mistakes cost days.
dialogue.zh: 請唸，出錯會拖好幾天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Name correct, address correct.
dialogue.zh: 名字正確，地址也正確。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the email spelled right?
dialogue.zh: 信箱也有拼對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also the postal code, all five.
dialogue.zh: 郵遞區號也對了，五碼全中。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the camera pointed at?
dialogue.zh: 那個鏡頭是對準什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A copy of your passport page.
dialogue.zh: 幫你的護照頁存一張影本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that picture stored safely?
dialogue.zh: 那份掃描存得安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stays locked in this office.
dialogue.zh: 它鎖在我們這間辦公室裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not online somewhere, I hope.
dialogue.zh: 希望它不在網路上的哪裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Offline, with all our paper records.
dialogue.zh: 離線的，跟紙本資料放一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can give the book back now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn ɡɪv ðə bʊk bæk naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 護照本現在可以還我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's your little book, safe.
dialogue.zh: 你的小本子，完璧歸趙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inner pocket, click. Good.
dialogue.zh: 收進內袋，喀噠一聲。好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Registration needs one final thing.
dialogue.zh: 登記還差最後一個動作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more signature, where exactly?
dialogue.zh: 再簽一個名，確切簽在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here, small beside the X.
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡，叉號旁邊小小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same name as on the contract?
dialogue.zh: 跟合約上一樣的名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just use your best printing letters.
dialogue.zh: 用工整的大寫慢慢寫就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Signed, sealed, delivered.
dialogue.zh: 簽好、蓋章、交件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done! Welcome to the family.
dialogue.zh: 完成！歡迎加入我們家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The family? That sounds warm.
dialogue.zh: 一家人？這說法挺溫暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We say it for all new members.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi seɪ ɪt fɔr ɔl nu ˈmɛmbərz./
dialogue.zh: 每位新門號我們都這麼說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, may I choose my number?
dialogue.zh: 現在，我可以挑號碼了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Here's a list of fresh ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs! hɪrz ə lɪst əv frɛʃ wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 當然！這是一整列空號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So many digits, my eyes spin.
dialogue.zh: 這麼多數字，看得眼花。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick one easy for friends to say.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪk wʌn ˈizi fɔr frɛndz tə seɪ./
dialogue.zh: 挑一組朋友好唸的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This ending, four two four two?
dialogue.zh: 這個尾數，四二四二？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy to say, I'd pick that one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi tə seɪ, aɪd pɪk ðæt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 好唸順口，我也挑這組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take the number ending in two.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk ðə ˈnʌmbər ˈɛndɪŋ ɪn tu./
dialogue.zh: 我要這組尾數是二的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chosen! It's yours from today.
dialogue.zh: 選定了！今天起它是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I text the number around?
dialogue.zh: 能馬上用傳的告訴別人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save it first, then share it widely.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ɪt fɜrst, ðɛn ʃɛr ɪt ˈwaɪdli./
dialogue.zh: 先存進手機，再慢慢分享。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll write it on this paper slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl raɪt ɪt ɑn ðɪs ˈpeɪpər slɪp./
dialogue.zh: 我先把號碼寫在字條上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it in your wallet tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚就先放在錢包裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do I get to carry home?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du aɪ ɡɛt tə ˈkæri hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以帶哪些東西回家？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This folder holds your contract copy.
dialogue.zh: 這個資料夾放著合約正本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And this sealed blue envelope?
dialogue.zh: 那這個封好的藍信封呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your new SIM card, still sealed.
dialogue.zh: 你的新電話卡，還封著口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It looks like a plain gift card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lʊks laɪk ə pleɪn ɡɪft kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 看起來就像一張禮卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open it at the small table, soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ɪt æt ðə smɔl ˈteɪbəl, sun./
dialogue.zh: 等一下在小桌上拆開它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we swapping the card now?
dialogue.zh: 我們現在就要換卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, step by step, together here.
dialogue.zh: 對，就在這裡一步一步來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My roommate should come too.
dialogue.zh: 我室友也該來辦一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring him by, we'll take good care.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ hɪm baɪ, wil teɪk ɡʊd kɛr./
dialogue.zh: 帶他來，我們會照顧好他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have student deals there?
dialogue.zh: 你們有學生優惠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with a school card, ten off.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wɪð ə skul kɑrd, tɛn ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 有，憑學生證每月少十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He'll love that, he's a student.
dialogue.zh: 他會很愛，他還在讀書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then he must visit us this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hi məst ˈvɪzɪt ʌs ðɪs wik./
dialogue.zh: 那這週就一定要帶他來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything else I should know today?
dialogue.zh: 今天還有什麼該記住的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One tip: save our store number.
dialogue.zh: 給你一招：存下門市電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The back of the folder has it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæk əv ðə ˈfoʊldər hæz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 資料夾背面就印著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We answer faster than the hotline.
dialogue.zh: 我們比客服專線接得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hotline takes forever, right?
dialogue.zh: 客服專線都要等很久，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, so use this store.
dialogue.zh: 動不動二十分鐘，所以找本店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted, plus the app for bills.
dialogue.zh: 記下了，繳帳單就用app。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You've remembered everything already.
dialogue.zh: 你已經全部記熟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I took notes, it's an old habit.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tʊk noʊts, ɪts ən oʊld ˈhæbɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我做了筆記，這是老習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart habit, keep those notes close.
dialogue.zh: 好習慣，筆記要收在手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, are we fully done signing?
dialogue.zh: 所以，簽約的部分結束了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Signing is done, the swap is next.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsaɪnɪŋ ɪz dʌn, ðə swɑp ɪz nɛkst./
dialogue.zh: 簽完啦，下一步是換卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are ready, show me.
dialogue.zh: 我的手準備好了，教我吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's move to the little table.
dialogue.zh: 我們移到那張小桌去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This table has a bright lamp.
dialogue.zh: 這張桌上有盞明亮的燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for tiny cards and trays.
dialogue.zh: 照小卡和小托盤剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I found my paperclip, see?
dialogue.zh: 我找到迴紋針了，看？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Excellent, we can start right now.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們這就開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my roommate learn this too?
dialogue.zh: 這些步驟室友也要學嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He can watch you do it once.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kæn wɑʧ ju du ɪt wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 他跟著你看一遍就懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, tell me step number one.
dialogue.zh: 好，告訴我第一步驟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step one: power your phone off.
dialogue.zh: 第一步：把手機關機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phone is off. What's step two?
dialogue.zh: 手機關機了。第二步？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gently push the clip into the tiny hole.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒɛntli pʊʃ ðə klɪp ˈɪntu ðə ˈtaɪni hoʊl./
dialogue.zh: 把迴紋針輕輕插進小洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this, on the side edge?
dialogue.zh: 像這樣，在側邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, right there, press just once.
dialogue.zh: 對，就是那裡，輕輕一頂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The little tray popped out!
dialogue.zh: 小托盤跳出來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, keep it flat on the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl, kip ɪt flæt ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 小心，讓它平躺在桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The old card is so tiny.
dialogue.zh: 舊卡好小一片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest it in the plastic frame now.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst ɪt ɪn ðə ˈplæstɪk freɪm naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在把它安進塑膠框。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, is this frame yours?
dialogue.zh: 等等，這個框是你店裡的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The spare I gave you, keep it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə spɛr aɪ ɡeɪv ju, kip ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 就我給你的那個備用框，收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where exactly does the new card sit?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪɡˈzæktli dʌz ðə nu kɑrd sɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 新卡確切要擺在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Notch matches corner, like a puzzle.
dialogue.zh: 缺口對角落，就像拼圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gold side up, is that right?
dialogue.zh: 金色面朝上，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, lay it flat and gently.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，平平地輕輕放好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tray slides back with a click.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪ slaɪdz bæk wɪð ə klɪk./
dialogue.zh: 托盤一推，喀噠一聲回位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That click is music to us.
dialogue.zh: 那聲喀噠就是我們愛聽的音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I press the power button?
dialogue.zh: 現在我按電源鍵？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, give it a minute to wake up.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɡɪv ɪt ə ˈmɪnɪt tə weɪk ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 對，給它一分鐘慢慢醒來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The brand picture is taking its time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði brænd ˈpɪktʃər ɪz ˈteɪkɪŋ ɪts taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 開機畫面拖得有點久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's searching, watch the top right.
dialogue.zh: 它在找訊號，盯右上角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One bar... then four bars!
dialogue.zh: 一格……變四格了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the network sees you.
dialogue.zh: 那就代表網路看見你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A welcome text just arrived.
dialogue.zh: 歡迎簡訊剛剛送達。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open it, your number is inside.
dialogue.zh: 打開吧，號碼就在裡頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My new number, written so clear.
dialogue.zh: 我的新號碼，寫得好清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save it under 'me' in your contacts.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ɪt ˈʌndər mi ɪn jʊr ˈkɑnˌtækts./
dialogue.zh: 在聯絡人裡存成「我自己」。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I call someone right now?
dialogue.zh: 我現在該撥給誰嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The best first test is a real call.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛst fɜrst tɛst ɪz ə riəl kɔl./
dialogue.zh: 最好的測試就是真的打一通。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll ring my roommate downstairs.
dialogue.zh: 我打給樓下的室友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect target, he can answer fast.
dialogue.zh: 完美人選，他接起來最快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's ringing, one, two, three...
dialogue.zh: 正在響，一、二、三……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hush now, let it ring a bit more.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌʃ naʊ, lɛt ɪt rɪŋ ə bɪt mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 噓，讓它再多響幾聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He picked up! Can you hear me?
dialogue.phonetic: /hi pɪkt ʌp! kæn ju hɪr mi?/
dialogue.zh: 他接了！聽得到我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask him if your voice sounds clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɪm ɪf jʊr vɔɪs saʊndz klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 問他你的聲音清不清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says I sound very clear.
dialogue.zh: 他說我講得非常清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First call complete, that's success.
dialogue.zh: 第一通完成，這就是成功。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This feels so strange but nice.
dialogue.zh: 感覺好奇怪，但又開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A new number always feels new.
dialogue.zh: 新號碼永遠帶著新鮮感。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I test the data right here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ tɛst ðə ˈdeɪtə raɪt hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 可以在這裡測試流量嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, open your browser app.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，打開你的瀏覽器app。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The page loads so fast, look.
dialogue.zh: 網頁跑得超快，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-five gigabytes, ready to travel.
dialogue.zh: 二十五GB，準備陪你上路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I play a video now?
dialogue.zh: 我現在放一段影片好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it proves your line is truly live.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt pruːvz jʊr laɪn ɪz ˈtruli laɪv./
dialogue.zh: 好，這能證明線路真的通了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It plays perfectly, no stopping.
dialogue.zh: 播放完全順暢，不卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then everything works as promised.
dialogue.zh: 那每樣功能都如當初承諾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the voicemail greeting?
dialogue.zh: 語音信箱的問候音呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call your own number when you're free.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl jʊr oʊn ˈnʌmbər wɛn jʊr fri./
dialogue.zh: 有空撥自己這支，它會引導你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press one, then record my voice?
dialogue.zh: 按一，然後錄我的聲音？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, keep the line short and friendly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, kip ðə laɪn ʃɔrt ænd ˈfrɛndli./
dialogue.zh: 對，句子要短，語氣要暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This month I'll speak slowly there.
dialogue.zh: 這個月我先慢慢錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Simple is best for a greeting.
dialogue.zh: 問候語嘛，簡單就是最好的。
