dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to restart tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚需要重開機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One restart locks in the network.
dialogue.zh: 重開一次，訊號就咬緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Off and on, that I can do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔf ænd ɑn, ðæt aɪ kæn du./
dialogue.zh: 關了再開，這個我會。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your hotspot can wait for home.
dialogue.zh: 熱點的部分留著回家再測。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I reach you after today?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ ritʃ ju ˈæftər təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 今天之後怎麼聯絡你們？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your welcome text has our store number.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈwɛlkəm tɛkst hæz ˈaʊər stɔr ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 歡迎簡訊裡就印著門市電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, saved it, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 找到了，存好了，謝謝妳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're a faster learner than most.
dialogue.zh: 你比多數人上手都快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My old prepaid, should I warn friends?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ oʊld ˌpriˈpeɪd, ʃʊd aɪ wɔrn frɛndz?/
dialogue.zh: 舊的那支，我要提醒朋友嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it fades away in sixty days.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt feɪdz əˈweɪ ɪn ˈsɪksti deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 要，舊門號六十天就消失。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty days is plenty of time.
dialogue.zh: 六十天相當夠用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send one group text with new digits.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd wʌn ɡrup tɛkst wɪð nu ˈdɪdʒɪts./
dialogue.zh: 發一則群組簡訊報新號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my mom know my new number?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl maɪ mɑm noʊ maɪ nu ˈnʌmbər?/
dialogue.zh: 我媽會知道我的新號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text it to her twice, she'll save it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst ɪt tə hɜr twaɪs, ʃiːl seɪv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 傳兩則給她，她會存起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I'll do that while fresh.
dialogue.zh: 好，趁記憶新鮮我馬上傳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Number memory fades by tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 數字這種記憶隔天就淡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I still use wifi at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ stɪl juz ˈwaɪfi æt hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 家裡還是可以連Wi-Fi嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, and it saves your gigabytes.
dialogue.zh: 當然，還會幫你把GB存住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the plan counts only phone use?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə plæn kaʊnts ˈoʊnli foʊn juz?/
dialogue.zh: 所以方案只算手機的用量？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, wifi never touches your data.
dialogue.zh: 對，Wi-Fi永遠不碰你的流量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then my twenty-five lasts even longer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn maɪ ˈtwɛnti faɪv læsts ˈivɪn ˈlɔŋgər./
dialogue.zh: 那我的二十五GB會更耐用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At home you'll hardly spend any.
dialogue.zh: 在家裡你幾乎一點都不耗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My budget sends its thanks.
dialogue.zh: 我的預算向你致謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Monthly, you'll see the savings.
dialogue.zh: 每個月都會看見省下的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the card stops working later?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ðə kɑrd stɑps ˈwɜrkɪŋ ˈleɪtər?/
dialogue.zh: 之後卡片忽然不能用怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean the gold chips, then reseat it.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin ðə ɡoʊld tʃɪps, ðɛn risit ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 擦擦金色晶片，再重插一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reseat, like taking it out again?
dialogue.zh: 重插，就是再拔出來一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes: off, out, wipe, back in.
dialogue.zh: 對：關機、拔出、擦一下、放回。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little ritual for phones, nice.
dialogue.zh: 對手機的小儀式，挺好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Phones are shy, be patient with them.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊnz ɑr ʃaɪ, bi ˈpeɪʃənt wɪð ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 手機害羞，對它耐心一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything to set in the app tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniθɪŋ tə sɛt ɪn ði æp təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 今晚app裡還要設定什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn on that alert at twenty.
dialogue.zh: 把二十GB那個提醒開起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty gigabytes, that's my alarm.
dialogue.zh: 二十GB，就是我的警示線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll get a text, then relax.
dialogue.zh: 你會收到簡訊，然後安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says saved, I did it right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz seɪvd, aɪ dɪd ɪt raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 畫面說已儲存，我做對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now you carry no worries home.
dialogue.zh: 現在你什麼都不用擔心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The first bill will show thirty-six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɜrst bɪl wɪl ʃoʊ ˈθɜrdi sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 第一張帳單會是三十六元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-three, plus nine, plus four.
dialogue.zh: 二十三，加九，再加四。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have it written in my notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ɪt ˈrɪtn̩ ɪn maɪ noʊts./
dialogue.zh: 我已經寫進筆記裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the first, you'll see it arrive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə fɜrst, jul si ɪt əˈraɪv./
dialogue.zh: 一到月初，你就看見它來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By email, or inside the app?
dialogue.zh: 是信箱收到，還是app裡看？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app shows it a day sooner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp ʃoʊz ɪt ə deɪ ˈsunər./
dialogue.zh: app裡通常會早一天看到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything finally feels settled.
dialogue.zh: 一切終於都塵埃落定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome to your new phone plan.
dialogue.zh: 歡迎使用你的新手機方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for the patient hours.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝妳幾個小時的耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pleasure. Come by next month.
dialogue.zh: 我的榮幸，下個月再來坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next month I may bring questions.
dialogue.zh: 下個月我可能帶著問題來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring them, the coffee is free.
dialogue.zh: 帶來吧，店裡的咖啡是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello again, it's me, the newcomer.
dialogue.zh: 又見面了，是我，那個新人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome back! How's the plan?
dialogue.zh: 歡迎回來！方案用得如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It runs great, but I have a puzzle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt rʌnz ɡreɪt, bʌt aɪ hæv ə ˈpʌzəl./
dialogue.zh: 跑得很順，但我遇到一個謎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A puzzle? Let's see it then.
dialogue.zh: 謎題？那我們一起來看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My first bill says thirty-six dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fɜrst bɪl sɛz ˈθɜrdi sɪks ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 我的第一張帳單寫著三十六元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And you expected twenty-three, right?
dialogue.zh: 而你以為會是二十三元，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly! I wrote it in my notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli! aɪ roʊt ɪt ɪn maɪ noʊts./
dialogue.zh: 對啊！我還寫在筆記裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your notes are good, the bill is honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr noʊts ɑr ɡʊd, ðə bɪl ɪz ˈɑnɪst./
dialogue.zh: 筆記沒記錯，帳單也沒亂寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then why the gap of thirteen?
dialogue.zh: 那為什麼中間差了十三元？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's read it line by line.
dialogue.zh: 我們一行一行慢慢讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Line one: monthly plan, twenty-three.
dialogue.zh: 第一行：月租方案，二十三元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That matches our agreement exactly.
dialogue.zh: 這跟我們的約定完全吻合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Line two: service fee, nine dollars.
dialogue.zh: 第二行：服務費，九元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the activation, one-time only.
dialogue.zh: 那是開通費，只收這一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Activation! You did mention nine.
dialogue.zh: 開通費！你們確實提過九元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It never returns after this bill.
dialogue.zh: 這張之後它就永遠不來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Line three is taxes, four dollars.
dialogue.zh: 第三行是稅金，四元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tax lives here, nothing new.
dialogue.zh: 稅一直在這裡，不是新東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So twenty-three plus nine plus four.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈtwɛnti θri plʌs naɪn plʌs fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 所以二十三加九再加四。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty-six, exactly as printed.
dialogue.zh: 三十六元，跟印出來的一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The math works. I panicked early.
dialogue.zh: 數學是對的，我太早慌張了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally normal, bills surprise everyone.
dialogue.zh: 很正常，帳單人人都會嚇一跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Line four, is that a due date?
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪn fɔr, ɪz ðæt ə du deɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 第四行，那個是繳費期限嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you pay by the fifteenth.
dialogue.zh: 對，十五號之前要繳清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I got the bill on the second.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɑt ðə bɪl ɑn ðə ˈsɛkənd./
dialogue.zh: 我二號就收到帳單了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So you have nearly two weeks.
dialogue.zh: 所以你還有將近兩週時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If I miss it, the five dollar fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ mɪs ɪt, ðə faɪv ˈdɑlər fi./
dialogue.zh: 如果錯過，就是五元罰費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set a phone reminder tonight, okay?
dialogue.zh: 今晚就設個手機提醒，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app can pay the whole thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp kæn peɪ ðə hoʊl θɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 那個app可以整筆繳掉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One tap, then a receipt appears.
dialogue.zh: 點一下，收據就浮現出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please show me, I'll watch closely.
dialogue.zh: 請示範給我看，我會盯緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the app, tap the blue button.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ði æp, tæp ðə blu ˈbʌtən./
dialogue.zh: 打開app，按藍色那個按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says, pay the full amount.
dialogue.zh: 上面寫著，一次付清全額。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Confirm it, the payment finishes today.
dialogue.zh: 按確認，今天這筆就結清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paid! The screen says thank you.
dialogue.zh: 繳好了！畫面在說謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The receipt saves inside the app.
dialogue.zh: 收據會好好存在app裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I see old bills in there too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ si oʊld bɪlz ɪn ðɛr tu?/
dialogue.zh: 那裡面也看得到舊帳單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every month files itself for a year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri mʌnθ faɪlz ɪtˈsɛlf fɔr ə jɪr./
dialogue.zh: 每個月的都會自己存檔一年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So no paper mountain at home.
dialogue.zh: 家裡就不會堆出紙山了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask anytime for paper, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過想要紙本隨時開口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I use all my data, by the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd aɪ juz ɔl maɪ ˈdeɪtə, baɪ ðə weɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 對了，我的流量用光了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bill carries a data page too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪl ˈkæriz ə ˈdeɪtə peɪdʒ tu./
dialogue.zh: 帳單後面也附了流量頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says, twenty-one gigabytes used.
dialogue.zh: 上面寫用掉二十一GB。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four left at the month's end.
dialogue.zh: 月底還剩下四GB呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The alert text helped me a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði əˈlɜrt tɛkst hɛlpt mi ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 那則提醒簡訊幫了我大忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, the quiet app earns its keep.
dialogue.phonetic: /siː, ðə ˈkwaɪət æp ɜrnz ɪts kip./
dialogue.zh: 看吧，那個app很稱職。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hotspot barely got touched.
dialogue.zh: 我的熱點幾乎沒被用到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under one gigabyte, just emails.
dialogue.zh: 不到一GB，只有收發信件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: International minutes, a big zero.
dialogue.zh: 國際電話分鐘數，大大的零。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You skipped that add-on, wisely.
dialogue.zh: 你當初沒加購，真聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the bill holds no junk lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə bɪl hoʊldz noʊ dʒʌŋk laɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 所以帳單上沒有垃圾項目。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three lines, all explained tonight.
dialogue.zh: 三行數字，今晚全部解開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel silly for worrying so much.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil ˈsɪli fɔr ˈwɜriɪŋ soʊ mʌtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 我擔心那麼多，顯得傻傻的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First bills confuse every single person.
dialogue.zh: 第一張帳單人人都會愣一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My roommate got his today too.
dialogue.zh: 我室友今天也拿到他的帳單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then teach him, like we did here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn titʃ hɪm, laɪk wi dɪd hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 那你就像剛才這樣教他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He already called me five times.
dialogue.zh: 他已經打了五次給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring him, we have free coffee.
dialogue.zh: 帶他來吧，我們有免費咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The coffee! That's why I came back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɔfi! ðæts waɪ aɪ keɪm bæk./
dialogue.zh: 就是咖啡！我回來的理由。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We keep answers, plus the coffee.
dialogue.zh: 我們備著答案，也備著咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Answers and coffee, a good pair.
dialogue.zh: 答案加咖啡，很棒的組合。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our store secret, don't tell anyone.
dialogue.zh: 這是門市秘方，先別張揚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more question, be honest.
dialogue.zh: 再問最後一個問題，誠實點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try me, I like your questions.
dialogue.zh: 問吧，我喜歡你的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next month, is it twenty-seven?
dialogue.zh: 下個月會是二十七元嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-three, plus four in taxes.
dialogue.zh: 二十三元，再加四元稅金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And that stays for the whole term.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðæt steɪz fɔr ðə hoʊl tɜrm./
dialogue.zh: 而整個合約期間都維持這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, unless the tax law shifts.
dialogue.zh: 對，除非稅法忽然變動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two years suddenly feel shorter.
dialogue.zh: 兩年聽起來忽然變短了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This month flew, didn't it?
dialogue.zh: 這一個月飛得很快，不是嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It did, the plan is really smooth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dɪd, ðə plæn ɪz ˈrɪli smuð./
dialogue.zh: 真的，這個方案順得不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smooth is exactly our goal.
dialogue.zh: 平順正是我們追求的目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my mom get a plan like this?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn maɪ mɑm ɡɛt ə plæn laɪk ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 我媽也能辦這樣的方案嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'd need her own passport first.
dialogue.zh: 她得先帶著自己的護照來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She carries it like a trophy.
dialogue.zh: 她帶護照像帶著獎盃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then she's our easiest customer.
dialogue.zh: 那她就是最好的客人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My roommate signed up yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 我室友昨天辦好登記了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The student deal, ten dollars off.
dialogue.zh: 用了學生優惠，少十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His number also ends in two.
dialogue.zh: 他的號碼尾數也是二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You two like matching endings.
dialogue.zh: 你們倆喜歡一樣的結尾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which plan fit him in the end?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ plæn fɪt hɪm ɪn ði ɛnd?/
dialogue.zh: 到最後哪個方案適合他？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Basic suits him, he barely streams.
dialogue.zh: 基礎方案配他，他很少串流。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same store, two different plans.
dialogue.zh: 同一家店，兩種不同方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's how good shopping works.
dialogue.zh: 好的購物體驗就該這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Remember my first day here?
dialogue.zh: 還記得我第一天來的樣子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You asked a hundred small questions.
dialogue.zh: 你問了上百個小問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And you answered every one.
dialogue.zh: 而妳每一題都回答了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's my favorite part of the job.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt pɑrt əv ðə dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 那是我這工作上最喜歡的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee really is on me today.
dialogue.zh: 今天的咖啡真的該我請。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll allow it, then one more cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl əˈlaʊ ɪt, ðɛn wʌn mɔr kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 那我不客氣，再來一杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next month, just curiosity, promise.
dialogue.zh: 下個月來只帶好奇心，保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring bills, we bring answers here.
dialogue.zh: 帳單你們帶，答案我們備。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty-seven dollars, every month.
dialogue.zh: 二十七元，每一個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the number, no surprises.
dialogue.zh: 就是這個數，不會有意外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone finally feels like home.
dialogue.zh: 我的手機終於有了家的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the best thing to hear.
dialogue.zh: 這是最動聽的一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I should let you help the next guest.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ʃʊd lɛt ju hɛlp ðə nɛkst ɡɛst./
dialogue.zh: 我該讓妳去幫下一位客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're family, take the last cookie.
dialogue.zh: 你是自己人，餅乾留給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Night, I'll see you on the first.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪt, aɪl si ju ɑn ðə fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，我月初再過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep well, your line is all set.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip wɛl, jʊr laɪn ɪz ɔl sɛt./
dialogue.zh: 好好睡，你的門號萬事俱備。
